description: This file provides a React hook and utility functions for progressive batch processing of work items, managing scheduling with requestIdleCallback or setTimeout fallback, and exposing an API to start, cancel, and monitor progress in a React application.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller object that manages the progressive batch processing of items, scheduling work with requestIdleCallback or setTimeout, and provides start and cancel methods.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: React hook that wraps the controller to provide UI state management (running, progress, counts) and convenient start/cancel functions for progressive work processing.
